```{ojs}
md`### Notes
- **Rainfall data:** per-year seasonal PTOT COGs (D409 obs pipeline, \`processing=seasonal\`,
  \`PTOT_{SEASON}_{YYYY}_sum.tif\`), one fetch per panel; monthly-sum fallback if a
  year is missing. Anomaly subtracts the 1991–2020 climatology COG. 2026 excluded.
- **Drought data (SPEI-3):** monthly per-pixel COGs (\`processing=monthly/variable=SPEI-03\`,
  \`SPEI-03-{YYYY}-{MM}.tif\`), read at the season-end month (OND → Dec, MAM → May) — a
  3-month accumulation already covers the season. SPEI is already a standardised anomaly
  (−ve drier, +ve wetter), so the anomaly toggle is disabled for it.
- **Vegetation data (NDVI):** MODIS **MOD13Q1** v061 per-year seasonal-mean COGs (250 m,
  \`type=vegetation/source=modis-mod13q1/region=east-africa\`), real NDVI (DN/10000, ~0–1),
  pixel-reliability masked. Its own 250 m East-Africa grid (≠ the ~5 km CHIRPS grid) so the
  read window + county mask recompute for it. Anomaly toggle disabled (no NDVI climatology COG yet).
- **Flood data (observed):** Copernicus **GFM** (Sentinel-1 SAR, ~111 m) seasonal 0/1 occurrence COGs
  (\`type=flood/source=glofas-gfm/region=kenya/processing=seasonal/variable=flooded/season={S}/flooded_{S}_{YYYY}.tif\`),
  2018–2025 — replaced the old GFD/MODIS. Coding 0/1/**255=not-observed** (SAR gap → mapped to NaN, not
  dry). Card mean = flooded share of the SAR-observed county area. Short record = recent flood-proneness,
  NOT return-period magnitude (use JRC below for that); don't splice with the old GFD (methodological
  break). Own ~111 m grid. (History \`frequency\`/\`footprint\` COGs also live — candidate static layer.)
- **Flood hazard (JRC GloFAS):** static return-period flood **depth (m)** COGs (90 m,
  \`type=flood/source=jrc-glofas/…/rp={RP}/flood-depth_rp{RP}.tif\`), one map per return period
  (10–500 yr) via the RP slider. **Static** — same every year, independent of ENSO; it answers
  "where is flood-prone + how deep", read alongside the observed-flood years. Own 90 m grid.
- **Correlation:** Pearson r between the county-mean seasonal value (rainfall *or* SPEI-3)
  and each driver's standardised index over the selected years (n shown). Higher |r| = that
  driver explains more of this county's outcome that season; +r → driver-high raises the outcome
  (wetter / greener / better crop-water / more flood, per the selected variable).
- **Filter:** min/max on the section driver's value (raw index for single drivers,
  composite z for ENSO+IOD). Card colour + phase still standardised (z vs 1991–2020).
- **Deferred:** multi-county maps (#3); NDVI annual composite + anomaly-vs-climatology (v1 = seasonal
  OND/MAM only); NPP/biomass (superseded by NDVI); WRSI; riverine flood — see dispatches 2026-08.`
```

```{ojs}
currentState = {
  const n34 = drivers.filter((d) => d.nino34_anom_noaa != null);
  const oni = d3.mean(n34.slice(-3), (d) => d.nino34_anom_noaa);
  const asOf = n34.slice(-1)[0].date;
  const dmiRows = drivers.filter((d) => d.dmi_hadisst != null || d.dmi_ersst != null);
  const last = dmiRows.slice(-1)[0];
  const dmi = last ? (last.dmi_hadisst ?? last.dmi_ersst) : null;
  const phase = oni > 0.5 ? "El Niño" : oni < -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "neutral";
  return {oni, dmi, phase, asOf};
}
```

<!-- ---- map engine ---- -->

```{ojs}
// jsdelivr +esm (bundled) is more reliable than esm.sh here: esm.sh splits geotiff
// into many transitive chunk fetches and any one rate-limiting rejects the whole
// dynamic import ("Failed to fetch dynamically imported module").
geotiffLib = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/geotiff@2.1.3/+esm")
topojsonClient = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/+esm")
```

```{ojs}
// Official Kenya IEBC boundaries (COD-AB, source=IEBC) — NOT GAUL (GAUL carries the
// disputed Ilemi Triangle + no p-codes). adm1 = 47 counties, adm2 = 290 sub-counties;
// both carry gaul1_code (injected via name match) so existing joins work, + adm2_pcode.
admTopo = FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/ken_adm2_iebc_simple.topojson").json()
adm1Topo = FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/ken_adm1_iebc_simple.topojson").json()
countyGaul = new Map(counties.map((c) => [c.county, +c.gaul1_code]))
kenA2 = {
  const tc = await topojsonClient;
  return tc.feature(admTopo, admTopo.objects["ken_adm2"]).features;
}
kenA1 = {
  const tc = await topojsonClient;
  return tc.feature(adm1Topo, adm1Topo.objects["ken_adm1"]).features;
}
```

```{ojs}
// match geometry by gaul1_code (robust to county-name spelling diffs), not string name.
countySubs = kenA2.filter((f) => f.properties.gaul1_code === countyGaul.get(county))
countyA1 = kenA1.find((f) => f.properties.gaul1_code === countyGaul.get(county))
```

```{ojs}
ringsOf = (feature) => {
  const g = feature.geometry, out = [];
  const push = (poly) => poly.forEach((ring) => out.push(ring));
  if (g.type === "Polygon") push(g.coordinates);
  else if (g.type === "MultiPolygon") g.coordinates.forEach(push);
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
countyBbox = {
  let xmin = Infinity, ymin = Infinity, xmax = -Infinity, ymax = -Infinity;
  for (const ring of ringsOf(countyA1))
    for (const [x, y] of ring) {
      if (x < xmin) xmin = x; if (x > xmax) xmax = x;
      if (y < ymin) ymin = y; if (y > ymax) ymax = y;
    }
  const px = (xmax - xmin) * 0.08, py = (ymax - ymin) * 0.08;
  return [xmin - px, ymin - py, xmax + px, ymax + py];
}
```

```{ojs}
monthlyDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=monthly/variable=PTOT"
monthlyURL = (y, m) => `${monthlyDir}/PTOT-${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}.tif`
seasonalDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=seasonal/variable=PTOT"
seasonalURL = (season, year) => `${seasonalDir}/season=${season}/PTOT_${season}_${year}_sum.tif`
climDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=climatology/variable=PTOT/period=annual/clim=wmo_1991-2020/stat=max"
seasonMonthsFor = ({OND: [10, 11, 12], MAM: [3, 4, 5]})
YEAR_LO = 1981
YEAR_HI = 2025
// SPEI-3 (3-month drought index) — monthly per-pixel COGs; read at the season-end
// month (OND→Dec, MAM→May): the 3-month accumulation already spans the season.
speiDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=monthly/variable=SPEI-03"
speiURL = (y, m) => `${speiDir}/SPEI-03-${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}.tif`
seasonEndMonth = ({OND: 12, MAM: 5})
isSpei = mapVar.startsWith("Drought")
// MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI (250 m, East-Africa extent) — per-year seasonal mean COG,
// real NDVI (DN/10000), ~[-0.2, 1], NoData=NaN. Different grid to PTOT/SPEI.
ndviDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=vegetation/source=modis-mod13q1/region=east-africa/processing=seasonal/variable=NDVI"
ndviURL = (season, year) => `${ndviDir}/season=${season}/NDVI_${season}_${year}_mean.tif`
isNdvi = mapVar.startsWith("Vegetation")
// Copernicus GFM (Sentinel-1 SAR, ~111 m) observed flood — SEASONAL per year, 2018–2025
// (replaced GFD/MODIS 2000–2018). Coding: 0 = observed-not-flooded, 1 = flooded,
// 255 = NOT OBSERVED (SAR gap → treat as no-data, NOT dry).
floodDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=flood/source=glofas-gfm/region=kenya/processing=seasonal/variable=flooded"
floodURL = (season, year) => `${floodDir}/season=${season}/flooded_${season}_${year}.tif`
isFlood = mapVar.startsWith("Flood")
// JRC GloFAS return-period flood HAZARD (90 m, Kenya) — static depth (m) per RP.
// Independent of the map-variable machinery: its own window + render below.
jrcDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=flood/source=jrc-glofas/region=east-africa/processing=return-period/variable=flood-depth"
jrcURL = (rp) => `${jrcDir}/rp=${rp}/flood-depth_rp${rp}.tif`
// FEWS/USGS CHIRPS-ETos WRSI (10 km, Kenya) — per-season end-of-season % (0–100).
// Two domain variants: cropland (maize calendar) vs rangeland (pastoral/ASAL).
wrsiDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=agriculture/source=fews-wrsi/region=east-africa/processing=seasonal/variable=wrsi"
wrsiURL = (crop, season, year) => `${wrsiDir}/crop=${crop}/season=${season}/wrsi_${crop}_${season}_${year}.tif`
isWrsi = mapVar.startsWith("Crop-water")
```

```{ojs}
// reference COG for the read grid: NDVI (250 m, East-Africa) has its own origin/
// resolution/extent, so the window + mask must be computed on the matching grid.
gridRefURL = isWrsi ? wrsiURL(wrsiCrop, "OND", 2015) : isFlood ? floodURL("OND", 2019) : isNdvi ? ndviURL("OND", 2015) : monthlyURL(2000, 1)
gridWindow = {
  const gt = await geotiffLib;
  const tiff = await gt.fromUrl(gridRefURL);
  const image = await tiff.getImage();
  const [ox0, oy0, ox1, oy1] = image.getBoundingBox();
  const W = image.getWidth(), H = image.getHeight();
  const xres = (ox1 - ox0) / W, yres = (oy1 - oy0) / H;
  const [bx0, by0, bx1, by1] = countyBbox;
  const px0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((bx0 - ox0) / xres));
  const px1 = Math.min(W, Math.ceil((bx1 - ox0) / xres));
  const py0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((oy1 - by1) / yres));
  const py1 = Math.min(H, Math.ceil((oy1 - by0) / yres));
  return {
    window: [px0, py0, px1, py1], w: px1 - px0, h: py1 - py0,
    bbox: [ox0 + px0 * xres, oy1 - py1 * yres, ox0 + px1 * xres, oy1 - py0 * yres],
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
countyMask = {
  const win = await gridWindow;
  const [bx0, by0, bx1, by1] = win.bbox, w = win.w, h = win.h;
  const rings = ringsOf(countyA1);
  const inside = (x, y) => {
    let c = false;
    for (const ring of rings)
      for (let i = 0, j = ring.length - 1; i < ring.length; j = i++) {
        const xi = ring[i][0], yi = ring[i][1], xj = ring[j][0], yj = ring[j][1];
        if (((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi)) c = !c;
      }
    return c;
  };
  const mask = new Uint8Array(w * h);
  for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) {
    const lat = by1 - (j + 0.5) / h * (by1 - by0);
    for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {
      const lon = bx0 + (i + 0.5) / w * (bx1 - bx0);
      mask[j * w + i] = inside(lon, lat) ? 1 : 0;
    }
  }
  return mask;
}
```

```{ojs}
readWindow = async (url, win) => {
  const gt = await geotiffLib;
  const tiff = await gt.fromUrl(url);
  const image = await tiff.getImage();
  const rr = await image.readRasters({window: win.window});
  const src = rr[0], out = new Float32Array(src.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
    const v = src[i];
    out[i] = (v == null || !isFinite(v) || v <= -9999) ? NaN : v;
  }
  return out;
}
loadMonthly = (y, m, win) => readWindow(monthlyURL(y, m), win)
climFor = (season, win) => readWindow(`${climDir}/PTOT_${season}_1991-2020_mean.tif`, win)
```

```{ojs}
// seasonal total for a year: prefer the published seasonal COG, BUT guard against
// the known-bad OND bake (PTOT_OND_*_sum.tif reads all-zero, 2026-08-13); fall
// back to summing the 3 monthly COGs if the seasonal read is missing or degenerate.
monthlySum = async (season, year, win) => {
  const mons = seasonMonthsFor[season];
  const grids = await Promise.all(mons.map((m) => loadMonthly(year, m, win)));
  const n = win.w * win.h, out = new Float32Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let s = 0, ok = true;
    for (const g of grids) { const v = g[i]; if (Number.isNaN(v)) { ok = false; break; } s += v; }
    out[i] = ok ? s : NaN;
  }
  return out;
}
seasonalYear = async (season, year, win) => {
  try {
    const d = await readWindow(seasonalURL(season, year), win);
    let mx = -Infinity, any = false;
    for (const v of d) if (!Number.isNaN(v)) { any = true; if (v > mx) mx = v; }
    if (any && mx > 0) return d; // valid seasonal COG
  } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
  return monthlySum(season, year, win); // degenerate/missing → monthly sum
}
// SPEI-3 for a season-year = a single monthly COG read at the season-end month.
speiYear = (season, year, win) => readWindow(speiURL(year, seasonEndMonth[season]), win)
// NDVI for a season-year = the per-year seasonal-mean COG (own 250 m grid).
ndviYear = (season, year, win) => readWindow(ndviURL(season, year), win)
// GFM seasonal flood for a season-year (2018–2025); maps 255 (SAR not-observed) → NaN
// so it is treated as no-data, never as flooded/dry.
gfmYear = async (season, year, win) => {
  if (year < 2018 || year > 2025) return null;
  const d = await readWindow(floodURL(season, year), win);
  for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) if (d[i] === 255) d[i] = NaN;
  return d;
}
// WRSI = per-season end-of-season % COG for the selected crop domain (own 10 km grid).
// Coverage starts 2003; earlier years have no COG → null (skip, avoid 404 noise).
wrsiYear = (crop, season, year, win) => year >= 2003 ? readWindow(wrsiURL(crop, season, year), win) : Promise.resolve(null)
```

```{ojs}
// RAW per-year data for a season — anomaly-INDEPENDENT, so toggling the anomaly view
// never refetches the COG stack (#5). Body references (yearsSel, variable flags,
// wrsiCrop, gridWindow) are the ONLY things that trigger a refetch; `anomaly` is not
// referenced here, so OJS keeps this cell (and the fetch) stable across the toggle.
rawCache = async (season) => {
  const win = await gridWindow;
  return Promise.all(yearsSel.map(async (year) => {
    let data;
    try {
      data = isWrsi ? await wrsiYear(wrsiCrop, season, year, win)
        : isFlood ? await gfmYear(season, year, win)
        : isNdvi ? await ndviYear(season, year, win)
        : isSpei ? await speiYear(season, year, win)
        : await seasonalYear(season, year, win);
    }
    catch (e) { return {year, data: null}; }
    return {year, data};
  }));
}
// anomaly climatology: ONE small COG, fetched only when the anomaly view applies
// (absolute rainfall). Toggling anomaly re-runs just this + the cheap derive below.
useAnom = anomaly && !isSpei && !isNdvi && !isFlood && !isWrsi
climForSeason = { const win = await gridWindow; return useAnom ? await climFor(activeSeason, win) : null; }
// DERIVE: apply the anomaly subtraction (if any) + compute the county mean. No fetch
// of the year stack — reuses the cached raw arrays, so the anomaly toggle is instant.
deriveCache = async (season) => {
  const raw = await seasonRawP.p, win = await gridWindow, mask = await countyMask;
  const clim = climForSeason, n = win.w * win.h;
  return raw.map(({year, data}) => {
    if (data == null) return {year, data: null, meanmm: null};
    let d = data;
    if (clim) {
      const o = new Float32Array(n);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) o[i] = (Number.isNaN(data[i]) || Number.isNaN(clim[i])) ? NaN : data[i] - clim[i];
      d = o;
    }
    if (isFlood) {
      // GFM: flooded share of the SAR-OBSERVED county area = flooded / observed(0|1).
      // 255 (not observed) is already NaN → excluded from BOTH numerator + denominator
      // (it is a SAR gap, not dry). null when the county had no observation that season.
      let flooded = 0, observed = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!mask[i]) continue;
        const v = d[i];
        if (!Number.isNaN(v) && v > -9999) { observed++; if (v > 0) flooded++; }
      }
      return {year, data: d, meanmm: observed ? flooded / observed : null};
    }
    let sum = 0, cnt = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const v = d[i]; if (mask[i] && !Number.isNaN(v) && v > -9999) { sum += v; cnt++; } }
    return {year, data: d, meanmm: cnt ? sum / cnt : null};
  });
}
// promise-wrapped so the grid can show a loader WHILE the COGs fetch. Only the active
// season is fetched (#4) — half the network of the old two-section panel.
seasonRawP = ({p: rawCache(activeSeason)})
seasonCacheP = ({p: deriveCache(activeSeason)})
seasonCache = await seasonCacheP.p
seasonKeys = (s) => s === "OND" ? ["ENSO (Niño 3.4)", "IOD (DMI)"] : ["ENSO (Niño 3.4)", "IOD (DMI)", "Western-V (WNP)"]
```

```{ojs}
driverOptions = ["ENSO + IOD", "ENSO (Niño 3.4)", "IOD (DMI)", "Western-V (WNP)"]
phaseDefs = ({
  "ENSO + IOD":       {members: ["nino34_anom_noaa", "dmi_hadisst"], pos: "El Niño/+IOD", neg: "La Niña/−IOD"},
  "ENSO (Niño 3.4)":  {members: ["nino34_anom_noaa"], pos: "El Niño", neg: "La Niña"},
  "IOD (DMI)":        {members: ["dmi_hadisst"],      pos: "+IOD",    neg: "−IOD"},
  "Western-V (WNP)":  {members: ["wnp_std_mam"],      pos: "High Western-V", neg: "Low Western-V"},
})
driverHint = (driver) => ({
  "ENSO (Niño 3.4)": "ONI °C — El Niño ≥0.5 (mod ≥1.0, strong ≥1.5); La Niña ≤−0.5",
  "IOD (DMI)": "DMI — +IOD ≥0.4 (mod ≥0.7, strong ≥1.0); −IOD ≤−0.4",
  "Western-V (WNP)": "WNP (std) — high ≥0.5 (mod ≥1.0, strong ≥1.5); low ≤−0.5",
  "ENSO + IOD": "composite z (std) — ≥0.5, mod ≥1.0, strong ≥1.5; negatives symmetric",
})[driver]
```

```{ojs}
zByYear = (col, mons) => {
  const byYear = d3.rollups(
    drivers.filter((d) => mons.includes(d.month) && d[col] != null),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d[col]), (d) => d.year);
  const ref = byYear.filter(([y]) => y >= 1991 && y <= 2020).map(([, v]) => v);
  const m = d3.mean(ref), s = d3.deviation(ref) || 1;
  return new Map(byYear.map(([y, v]) => [y, (v - m) / s]));
}
zSeries = (driver, season) => {
  const def = phaseDefs[driver], mons = seasonMonthsFor[season];
  const maps = def.members.map((c) => zByYear(c, mons));
  const raw = new Map();
  for (const y of maps[0].keys()) {
    const zs = maps.map((m) => m.get(y));
    if (zs.every((z) => z != null && !Number.isNaN(z))) raw.set(y, d3.mean(zs));
  }
  const ref = [...raw].filter(([y]) => y >= 1991 && y <= 2020).map(([, v]) => v);
  const m = d3.mean(ref), s = d3.deviation(ref) || 1;
  return new Map([...raw].map(([y, v]) => [y, (v - m) / s]));
}
rawSeasonMean = (col, season, year) => {
  const rows = drivers.filter((d) => seasonMonthsFor[season].includes(d.month) && d[col] != null && d.year === year);
  return rows.length ? d3.mean(rows, (d) => d[col]) : null;
}
```

```{ojs}
// value used by the min/max range filter: raw index for single drivers,
// composite z for ENSO+IOD (matches the guide thresholds shown).
driverValueFor = (driver, season, year) => {
  const def = phaseDefs[driver];
  return def.members.length === 1
    ? rawSeasonMean(def.members[0], season, year)
    : (zSeries(driver, season).get(year) ?? null);
}
// standardised z for the card colour
driverSignalFor = (driver, season, year) => ({z: zSeries(driver, season).get(year) ?? null})
// title label — raw index value(s), no category
labelFor = (driver, season, year) => {
  const f = (v) => v == null ? "—" : v.toFixed(2);
  const oni = () => f(rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", season, year));
  const dmi = () => f(rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", season, year));
  const wnp = () => f(rawSeasonMean("wnp_std_mam", season, year));
  if (driver === "ENSO + IOD") return `ENSO: ${oni()} · IOD: ${dmi()}`;
  if (driver === "ENSO (Niño 3.4)") return `ENSO: ${oni()}`;
  if (driver === "IOD (DMI)") return `IOD: ${dmi()}`;
  return `Western-V: ${wnp()}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Pearson r between county rainfall and each driver (over the cached years)
pearson = (pairs) => {
  const n = pairs.length; if (n < 3) return null;
  const mx = d3.mean(pairs, (p) => p.x), my = d3.mean(pairs, (p) => p.y);
  const cov = d3.sum(pairs, (p) => (p.x - mx) * (p.y - my));
  const sx = Math.sqrt(d3.sum(pairs, (p) => (p.x - mx) ** 2));
  const sy = Math.sqrt(d3.sum(pairs, (p) => (p.y - my) ** 2));
  return (sx && sy) ? cov / (sx * sy) : null;
}
// r between two aligned arrays (nulls dropped pairwise)
corrArr = (xs, ys) => pearson(xs.map((x, i) => ({x, y: ys[i]})).filter((p) => p.x != null && !Number.isNaN(p.x) && p.y != null))
// ---- small OLS + partial-correlation engine (evidence-based combination) ----
solveLin = (M, v) => {
  const n = v.length, A = M.map((r, i) => [...r, v[i]]);
  for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {
    let piv = c;
    for (let r = c + 1; r < n; r++) if (Math.abs(A[r][c]) > Math.abs(A[piv][c])) piv = r;
    if (Math.abs(A[piv][c]) < 1e-12) return null;
    [A[c], A[piv]] = [A[piv], A[c]];
    const d = A[c][c];
    for (let j = c; j <= n; j++) A[c][j] /= d;
    for (let r = 0; r < n; r++) if (r !== c) { const fr = A[r][c]; for (let j = c; j <= n; j++) A[r][j] -= fr * A[c][j]; }
  }
  return A.map((r) => r[n]);
}
// OLS of y on intercept + cols; returns {r2, predicted}
ols = (cols, y) => {
  const n = y.length, k = cols.length + 1;
  const A = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const row = [1]; for (const c of cols) row.push(c[i]); A.push(row); }
  const AtA = Array.from({length: k}, () => new Array(k).fill(0)), Aty = new Array(k).fill(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) for (let a = 0; a < k; a++) { Aty[a] += A[i][a] * y[i]; for (let b = 0; b < k; b++) AtA[a][b] += A[i][a] * A[i][b]; }
  const bcoef = solveLin(AtA, Aty);
  if (!bcoef) return null;
  const pred = A.map((row) => row.reduce((s, v, j) => s + v * bcoef[j], 0));
  const my = d3.mean(y), sstot = d3.sum(y.map((v) => (v - my) ** 2)), ssres = d3.sum(y.map((v, i) => (v - pred[i]) ** 2));
  return {r2: sstot > 0 ? 1 - ssres / sstot : null, predicted: pred};
}
// partial r of xk with y, controlling for the `others` predictors (residual method)
partialR = (xk, others, y) => {
  if (!others.length) return corrArr(xk, y);
  const fx = ols(others, xk), fy = ols(others, y);
  if (!fx || !fy) return null;
  return corrArr(xk.map((v, i) => v - fx.predicted[i]), y.map((v, i) => v - fy.predicted[i]));
}
shortName = (k) => k.replace(/ \(.*\)$/, "")
// evidence-based driver↔rainfall stats for a set of drivers: bivariate r,
// partial r (each driver controlling for the others), best-linear multiple R
// (adjusted for df), and predictor collinearity.
corrStats = (season, cache, keys) => {
  const zmaps = keys.map((k) => zSeries(k, season));
  const complete = cache.filter((c) => c.meanmm != null)
    .map((c) => ({y: c.meanmm, xs: zmaps.map((z) => z.get(c.year))}))
    .filter((r) => r.xs.every((v) => v != null && !Number.isNaN(v)));
  const n = complete.length;
  const y = complete.map((r) => r.y);
  const cols = keys.map((_, ki) => complete.map((r) => r.xs[ki]));
  const per = keys.map((k, ki) => ({
    key: k, name: shortName(k),
    r: corrArr(cols[ki], y),
    partial: partialR(cols[ki], cols.filter((_, j) => j !== ki), y),
  }));
  const full = n > keys.length + 1 ? ols(cols, y) : null;
  const R2 = full && full.r2 != null ? Math.max(0, full.r2) : null;
  const multiR = R2 != null ? Math.sqrt(R2) : null;
  const adjR2 = R2 != null && n > keys.length + 1 ? 1 - (1 - R2) * (n - 1) / (n - keys.length - 1) : null;
  const adjR = adjR2 != null ? Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, adjR2)) : null;
  let maxColl = 0, collPair = "";
  for (let a = 0; a < keys.length; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < keys.length; b++) {
    const rr = Math.abs(corrArr(cols[a], cols[b]) ?? 0);
    if (rr > maxColl) { maxColl = rr; collPair = `${shortName(keys[a])}↔${shortName(keys[b])}`; }
  }
  return {per, multiR, adjR, n, maxColl, collPair, k: keys.length};
}
corrHeader = (season, cache, keys) => {
  const s = corrStats(season, cache, keys);
  const f = (r) => r == null ? "—" : r.toFixed(2);
  const strength = (r) => { const a = Math.abs(r); return a < 0.2 ? "negligible" : a < 0.4 ? "weak" : a < 0.6 ? "moderate" : "strong"; };
  // rank by |partial| — the independent contribution (honest "which driver matters")
  const ranked = s.per.filter((p) => p.partial != null).sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.partial) - Math.abs(a.partial));
  const best = ranked[0];
  const chip = (p) => (best && p.key === best.key)
    ? html`<b style="color:#1b7837">${p.name} r=${f(p.r)} (partial ${f(p.partial)})</b>`
    : html`<span>${p.name} r=${f(p.r)} (partial ${f(p.partial)})</span>`;
  // does combining beat the best single? compare adjusted multiple-R to best |partial-driver| bivariate r
  const bestSingleR = best ? Math.abs(best.r ?? 0) : 0;
  const combineHelps = s.adjR != null && s.adjR > bestSingleR + 0.05;
  const outLbl = isWrsi ? `crop-water (WRSI ${wrsiCrop})` : isFlood ? "flooded-area fraction" : isNdvi ? "vegetation (NDVI)" : isSpei ? "drought (SPEI-3)" : "rainfall";
  // outcome-aware direction words (a positive r means "driver high → …")
  const dirHi = isFlood ? "more flood" : isNdvi ? "greener" : isWrsi ? "better crop-water" : "wetter";
  const dirLo = isFlood ? "less flood" : isNdvi ? "browner" : isWrsi ? "worse crop-water" : "drier";
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.92em;margin:0.2rem 0 0.5rem">
    <b>Driver ↔ ${outLbl} correlation</b> (${county} · ${season} · n=${s.n} yrs${s.n < 15 ? html` · <span style="color:#b45309">small sample — low power</span>` : ""}) —
    ${s.per.map((p, i) => html`${i ? " · " : ""}${chip(p)}`)}
    <div style="font-size:0.92em;color:#444;margin-top:2px">
      Strongest independent driver: <b>${best ? best.name : "—"}</b>${best ? ` (partial ${f(best.partial)}, ${strength(best.partial)}; ${best.partial > 0 ? `↑ → ${dirHi}` : `↑ → ${dirLo}`})` : ""}.
      Best linear combination R=${f(s.multiR)} (adj ${f(s.adjR)}).
      ${combineHelps
        ? html` <b>Combining the drivers improves skill</b> (adj R ${f(s.adjR)} &gt; best single ${f(bestSingleR)}) — a weighted multi-driver index beats any one alone.`
        : best && Math.abs(best.partial) >= 0.4
          ? html` Suggested ${season} driver: <b>${shortName(best.key)}</b> — combining adds little here.`
          : html` No driver is a strong predictor for this county &amp; season; combining doesn't rescue it.`}
      ${isFlood ? html`<br><i>Flood note: GFM SAR record is short (2018–2025, n≈8) — treat the correlation as indicative only.</i>` : ""}
    </div>
    <details style="font-size:0.85em;color:#555;margin-top:3px"><summary style="cursor:pointer">Method &amp; how to read it</summary>
      <div style="margin-top:4px;max-width:62rem">
        <b>r</b> = Pearson correlation of the county's seasonal ${outLbl} with a driver's standardised index (over ${s.n} yrs). +: driver high → ${dirHi}; −: driver high → ${dirLo}. |r|: &lt;0.2 negligible · 0.2–0.4 weak · 0.4–0.6 moderate · &gt;0.6 strong.<br>
        <b>partial r</b> = the same, but with the <i>other</i> drivers held constant — the driver's <b>independent</b> signal. This matters because the drivers are correlated (max ${s.collPair || "n/a"} r=${f(s.maxColl)}); raw r double-counts shared variance.<br>
        <b>Best linear combination R</b> = multiple regression of the ${outLbl} on all drivers (optimal weights) — the ceiling for a linear multi-driver index; <b>adj R</b> penalises extra predictors so a higher adj R is a genuine gain, not overfit (n is short, so treat as indicative).<br>
        Only science-standard measures are shown: single r, partial r, multiple-regression R. An A×B interaction term was removed (not a standard teleconnection method; nonlinear phase behaviour is better seen in the phase composites). Correlation ≠ causation.
      </div></details>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// card background from a user-selected diverging d3 palette (KE-21), z in [-2,2],
// lightened 45% toward white so it reads as a subtle tint behind the map.
cardInterp = ({PRGn: d3.interpolatePRGn, BrBG: d3.interpolateBrBG, RdBu: d3.interpolateRdBu, PuOr: d3.interpolatePuOr, RdYlBu: d3.interpolateRdYlBu, Spectral: d3.interpolateSpectral})[cardPalette]
cardColor = (z) => {
  if (z == null || Number.isNaN(z)) return "#ffffff";
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (z / 2 + 1) / 2)); // z∈[-2,2] → [0,1], 0=neg phase
  const c = d3.color(cardInterp(t)).rgb();
  const soft = [c.r, c.g, c.b].map((v) => Math.round(v + 0.45 * (255 - v)));
  return `rgb(${soft.join(",")})`;
}
cardLegend = (driver) => {
  const def = phaseDefs[driver];
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.78em;color:#555;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <span>Card colour — <b>${driver.replace(/ \(.*\)$/, "")}</b> phase &amp; strength:</span>
    <span>${def.neg}</span>
    <span style="display:inline-block;width:120px;height:14px;background:linear-gradient(to right, ${cardColor(-2)}, ${cardColor(0)}, ${cardColor(2)})"></span>
    <span>${def.pos}</span>
  </div>`;
}
// rainfall-cell colour scale — SAME inline format as cardLegend so the two align
rainCellLegend = () => {
  if (isFlood) return html`<div style="font-size:0.78em;color:#555;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <span>Map cells — <b>observed flood</b>:</span>
    <span>not flooded (transparent)</span>
    <span style="display:inline-block;width:16px;height:14px;background:#2171b5;vertical-align:middle"></span>
    <span>flooded that year</span>
  </div>`;
  const w = 120;
  const cv = html`<canvas width=${w} height=${14} style="vertical-align:middle"></canvas>`;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    const v = rainDomain[0] + (x / (w - 1)) * (rainDomain[1] - rainDomain[0]);
    const c = pixelColor(v); ctx.fillStyle = c || "#fff"; ctx.fillRect(x, 0, 1, 14);
  }
  const lbl = isWrsi ? `WRSI ${wrsiCrop} (crop-water %)` : isNdvi ? "NDVI vegetation index" : isSpei ? "SPEI-3 drought index" : (anomaly ? "anomaly" : "rainfall");
  const unit = (isNdvi || isSpei || isWrsi) ? "" : " (mm)";
  const loTag = isWrsi ? " (failure)" : isNdvi ? " (bare)" : isSpei ? " (dry)" : "";
  const hiTag = isWrsi ? " (good)" : isNdvi ? " (green)" : isSpei ? " (wet)" : "";
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.78em;color:#555;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <span>Map cells — <b>${lbl}</b>${unit}:</span>
    <span>${rainDomain[0]}${loTag}</span>
    ${cv}
    <span>${rainDomain[1]}${hiTag}</span>
  </div>`;
}
// both legends stacked, same inline format + left-aligned
sectionLegend = (driver) => html`<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.25rem;margin:0.1rem 0 0.6rem">${cardLegend(driver)}${rainCellLegend()}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
// filter the cached years by the driver range, render each as a panel
buildPanels = async (cache, season, driver, mn, mx) => {
  const win = await gridWindow;
  const lo = (mn == null || Number.isNaN(mn)) ? null : mn;
  const hi = (mx == null || Number.isNaN(mx)) ? null : mx;
  const rows = cache.filter((c) => {
    if (c.data == null) return false;
    if (lo == null && hi == null) return true;
    const v = driverValueFor(driver, season, c.year);
    if (v == null) return false;
    if (lo != null && v < lo) return false;
    if (hi != null && v > hi) return false;
    return true;
  });
  if (!rows.length) return [html`<div class="rain-panel-err">No years in the selected ${driver.replace(/ \(.*\)$/, "")} range</div>`];
  return rows.map((c) => renderRainPanel(
    {season, year: c.year, meanmm: c.meanmm, signal: driverSignalFor(driver, season, c.year),
     driver, label: labelFor(driver, season, c.year)},
    {data: c.data, w: win.w, h: win.h, bbox: win.bbox}));
}
```

```{ojs}
gridWrap = (nodes) => html`<div class="rain-grid"
  style="grid-template-columns:repeat(${Math.round(facetCols)}, minmax(0, 1fr))">${nodes}</div>`
// prominent honesty flag for the flood layer: it is ANNUAL, not seasonal.
floodNote = (season) => html`<div class="flood-note">ℹ️ <b>Observed ${season} flood</b> — Copernicus <b>GFM</b> (Sentinel-1 SAR, ~111 m), flooded in ≥1 valid overpass that season (permanent water excluded).
  <b>Short record 2018–2025</b> → recent flood-proneness, <b>not</b> return-period magnitude (use the JRC hazard map below for magnitude). Do not read a trend from ~8 years.
  Blue = flooded; blank = observed-not-flooded <i>or</i> a SAR gap. Card % = flooded share of the <b>SAR-observed</b> county area (255 = not-observed is excluded, not counted as dry); "no SAR observation" = the county had no valid overpass that season.</div>`
parseNum = (s) => {
  if (s == null) return null;
  const t = String(s).trim();
  if (t === "") return null;
  const v = Number(t);
  return Number.isNaN(v) ? null : v;
}
```

```{ojs}
// map-cell colours from a user-selected d3 palette (KE-21). Absolute rainfall =
// sequential; anomaly = diverging RdBu (brown/red drier ↔ blue wetter, 0-centred).
mapInterp = ({Blues: d3.interpolateBlues, YlGnBu: d3.interpolateYlGnBu, GnBu: d3.interpolateGnBu, Greens: d3.interpolateGreens, PuBu: d3.interpolatePuBu, BuPu: d3.interpolateBuPu, Viridis: d3.interpolateViridis, Cividis: d3.interpolateCividis, Magma: d3.interpolateMagma})[mapPalette]
rainDomain = isWrsi ? [0, 100] : isFlood ? [0, 1] : isNdvi ? [0, 0.8] : isSpei ? [-2.5, 2.5] : (anomaly ? [-300, 300] : [0, 900])
pixelColor = (v) => {
  if (v == null || !isFinite(v) || v <= -9999) return null;
  if (isWrsi) {
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v / 100)); // WRSI % → RdYlGn (red fail → green good)
    return d3.interpolateRdYlGn(t);
  }
  if (isFlood) {
    if (v <= 0) return null; // unflooded → transparent, only paint flooded pixels
    return "#2171b5"; // observed flood (binary 0/1) → solid blue
  }
  if (isNdvi) {
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (v - rainDomain[0]) / (rainDomain[1] - rainDomain[0])));
    return d3.interpolateYlGn(t); // 0 → pale (bare), 0.8 → dark green (vegetated)
  }
  if (isSpei) {
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (v - rainDomain[0]) / (rainDomain[1] - rainDomain[0])));
    return d3.interpolateBrBG(t); // 0 → brown (drought), 1 → teal/green (wet)
  }
  if (anomaly) {
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (v - rainDomain[0]) / (rainDomain[1] - rainDomain[0])));
    return cardInterp(t); // anomaly map shares the card's diverging palette (#6)
  }
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v / rainDomain[1]));
  return mapInterp(t);
}
```

```{ojs}
// responsive panel: canvas drawn at intrinsic px, CSS scales it to the grid
// column (image-rendering:pixelated keeps the faithful cells).
renderRainPanel = (spec, raster) => {
  const {data, w, h, bbox} = raster;
  const [bx0, by0, bx1, by1] = bbox;
  const aspect = ((bx1 - bx0) / (by1 - by0)) * Math.cos((by0 + by1) / 2 * Math.PI / 180);
  const W = 300, H = Math.max(140, Math.min(460, Math.round(W / aspect)));
  const tx = (lon) => (lon - bx0) / (bx1 - bx0) * W;
  const ty = (lat) => (by1 - lat) / (by1 - by0) * H;

  const colX = new Int32Array(w + 1), rowY = new Int32Array(h + 1);
  for (let i = 0; i <= w; i++) colX[i] = Math.round(i / w * W);
  for (let j = 0; j <= h; j++) rowY[j] = Math.round(j / h * H);

  const canvas = html`<canvas width=${W} height=${H}></canvas>`;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  const clip = new Path2D();
  for (const ring of ringsOf(countyA1)) {
    ring.forEach(([lon, lat], i) => i ? clip.lineTo(tx(lon), ty(lat)) : clip.moveTo(tx(lon), ty(lat)));
    clip.closePath();
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.clip(clip);
  for (let j = 0; j < h; j++)
    for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {
      const c = pixelColor(data[j * w + i]);
      if (!c) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.fillRect(colX[i], rowY[j], colX[i + 1] - colX[i], rowY[j + 1] - rowY[j]);
    }
  ctx.restore();

  const ringPath = (ring) => "M" + ring.map(([lon, lat]) => `${tx(lon).toFixed(1)},${ty(lat).toFixed(1)}`).join("L") + "Z";
  const subPaths = countySubs.flatMap((f) => ringsOf(f)).map(ringPath).join(" ");
  const cntyPaths = ringsOf(countyA1).map(ringPath).join(" ");
  const svg = html`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="none">
    <path d="${subPaths}" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="0.6" opacity="0.8"/>
    <path d="${cntyPaths}" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.4"/></svg>`;

  const meanmm = spec.meanmm;
  const meanTxt = meanmm == null ? (isFlood ? "no SAR observation" : "—")
    : isWrsi ? `${Math.round(meanmm)}% WRSI`
    : isFlood ? `${(meanmm * 100).toFixed(1)}% flooded`
    : isNdvi ? meanmm.toFixed(2)
    : isSpei ? `${meanmm > 0 ? "+" : ""}${meanmm.toFixed(2)}`
    : `${anomaly && meanmm > 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(meanmm)} mm`;
  return html`<div class="rain-panel" style="background:${cardColor(spec.signal.z)}">
    <div class="rain-title"><strong>${spec.year}</strong>
      <span class="rain-mean">${meanTxt}</span>
      <div class="rain-signal">${spec.label}</div></div>
    <div class="rain-stack">${canvas}${svg}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// JRC flood-hazard: own window read (90 m grid ≠ every other layer) + county stats.
jrcWindow = async (rp) => {
  const gt = await geotiffLib;
  const tiff = await gt.fromUrl(jrcURL(rp));
  const image = await tiff.getImage();
  const [ox0, oy0, ox1, oy1] = image.getBoundingBox();
  const W = image.getWidth(), H = image.getHeight();
  const xres = (ox1 - ox0) / W, yres = (oy1 - oy0) / H;
  const [bx0, by0, bx1, by1] = countyBbox;
  const px0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((bx0 - ox0) / xres));
  const px1 = Math.min(W, Math.ceil((bx1 - ox0) / xres));
  const py0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((oy1 - by1) / yres));
  const py1 = Math.min(H, Math.ceil((oy1 - by0) / yres));
  const win = {window: [px0, py0, px1, py1], w: px1 - px0, h: py1 - py0,
    bbox: [ox0 + px0 * xres, oy1 - py1 * yres, ox0 + px1 * xres, oy1 - py0 * yres]};
  const rr = await image.readRasters({window: win.window});
  const src = rr[0], n = win.w * win.h, data = new Float32Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const v = src[i]; data[i] = (v == null || !isFinite(v) || v <= -9999) ? NaN : v; }
  // county mask for this grid + depth stats over flood-prone pixels (depth > 0)
  const [mbx0, mby0, mbx1, mby1] = win.bbox, rings = ringsOf(countyA1);
  const inside = (x, y) => { let c = false;
    for (const ring of rings) for (let i = 0, j = ring.length - 1; i < ring.length; j = i++) {
      const xi = ring[i][0], yi = ring[i][1], xj = ring[j][0], yj = ring[j][1];
      if (((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi)) c = !c;
    } return c; };
  let inCounty = 0, floodCells = 0, sum = 0, mx = 0;
  for (let j = 0; j < win.h; j++) { const lat = mby1 - (j + 0.5) / win.h * (mby1 - mby0);
    for (let i = 0; i < win.w; i++) { const lon = mbx0 + (i + 0.5) / win.w * (mbx1 - mbx0);
      if (!inside(lon, lat)) continue; inCounty++;
      const v = data[j * win.w + i];
      if (!Number.isNaN(v) && v > 0) { floodCells++; sum += v; if (v > mx) mx = v; }
    } }
  return {...win, data, rp, share: inCounty ? floodCells / inCounty : 0,
    meanDepth: floodCells ? sum / floodCells : null, maxDepth: floodCells ? mx : null};
}
jrcDepthColor = (v) => {
  if (v == null || !isFinite(v) || v <= 0) return null; // no-flood / nodata → transparent
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v / 4)); // depth (m), cap 4 m for contrast
  return d3.interpolateBlues(0.2 + 0.8 * t);
}
jrcRender = (win) => {
  const {data, w, h, bbox} = win, [bx0, by0, bx1, by1] = bbox;
  const aspect = ((bx1 - bx0) / (by1 - by0)) * Math.cos((by0 + by1) / 2 * Math.PI / 180);
  const W = 560, H = Math.max(220, Math.min(720, Math.round(W / aspect)));
  const tx = (lon) => (lon - bx0) / (bx1 - bx0) * W, ty = (lat) => (by1 - lat) / (by1 - by0) * H;
  const colX = new Int32Array(w + 1), rowY = new Int32Array(h + 1);
  for (let i = 0; i <= w; i++) colX[i] = Math.round(i / w * W);
  for (let j = 0; j <= h; j++) rowY[j] = Math.round(j / h * H);
  const canvas = html`<canvas width=${W} height=${H}></canvas>`;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  const clip = new Path2D();
  for (const ring of ringsOf(countyA1)) {
    ring.forEach(([lon, lat], i) => i ? clip.lineTo(tx(lon), ty(lat)) : clip.moveTo(tx(lon), ty(lat)));
    clip.closePath();
  }
  ctx.save(); ctx.clip(clip);
  for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {
    const c = jrcDepthColor(data[j * w + i]); if (!c) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = c; ctx.fillRect(colX[i], rowY[j], colX[i + 1] - colX[i], rowY[j + 1] - rowY[j]);
  }
  ctx.restore();
  const ringPath = (ring) => "M" + ring.map(([lon, lat]) => `${tx(lon).toFixed(1)},${ty(lat).toFixed(1)}`).join("L") + "Z";
  const subPaths = countySubs.flatMap((f) => ringsOf(f)).map(ringPath).join(" ");
  const cntyPaths = ringsOf(countyA1).map(ringPath).join(" ");
  const svg = html`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="none" style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%">
    <path d="${subPaths}" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="0.6" opacity="0.8"/>
    <path d="${cntyPaths}" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.4"/></svg>`;
  const rampW = 120;
  const ramp = html`<canvas width=${rampW} height=${14} style="vertical-align:middle"></canvas>`;
  const rctx = ramp.getContext("2d");
  for (let x = 0; x < rampW; x++) { const c = jrcDepthColor((x / (rampW - 1)) * 4 + 0.001); rctx.fillStyle = c || "#fff"; rctx.fillRect(x, 0, 1, 14); }
  const stat = win.meanDepth == null
    ? html`<b>no modelled river flood</b> in ${county} at this return period`
    : html`flood-prone area <b>${(win.share * 100).toFixed(1)}%</b> of county · mean depth <b>${win.meanDepth.toFixed(2)} m</b> · max <b>${win.maxDepth.toFixed(1)} m</b>`;
  return html`<div>
    <div class="jrc-stack" style="max-width:${W}px">${canvas}${svg}</div>
    <div style="font-size:0.8em;color:#555;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:0.35rem">
      <span>Flood depth (m), 1-in-${win.rp}-yr:</span><span>0</span>${ramp}<span>≥4</span>
      <span style="margin-left:0.6rem">${stat}</span>
    </div></div>`;
}
```
